reason: Repair the PentaPR lifecycle so a governed PentaTagger request-budget deferral cannot suppress terminal PentaPR/PentaMerge/PentaCloser execution, while preserving provider request budgets, bounded authority, and provider readback requirements.

changes.reason: Bound repository-scale PentaTagger preflight and terminal readback sweeps to 24 entities so repeated five-minute lifecycle runs converge the PR backlog without reaching the 180-request provider safety budget and being misclassified as a hard workflow failure.

exclusions: No provider quota or request budget was raised or bypassed.
No credential, secret, or D3 authority was changed.
No pull request was deleted or silently replaced.
